answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one identity per biological entity. By requiring periodic biometric verification, these systems act as a lantern in the dawn of decentralized AI, forcing potential Sybil attackers to acquire illicit human credentials. The cost for an adversary involves scaling large-scale identity theft, akin to training a falcon to hunt through restricted airspace, making the deployment of mass malicious agents economically prohibitive within the network.
